messages.content:
Generate Python code based on the following instruction. Output ONLY code. DO NOT include explanations or other textual content.
Instruction: Generate code that creates an emulator with 10 stub Autonomous Systems (AS) and hosts. Then, create an Ethereum service with saveState set to True and override set to True. Create two blockchains, one based on Proof of Work (POW) and the other on Proof of Authority (POA). For each blockchain, create four nodes and set the first two nodes of each blockchain as bootnodes and start mining on them. For the third node of each blockchain, create accounts with a certain balance. For the fourth node of each blockchain, set custom geth command options. Enable HTTP and WebSocket connections on certain nodes and set custom geth binary file on one of the nodes. Customize the display names of the nodes for visualization purposes. Bind the virtual nodes to physical nodes using filters. Add the Ethereum layer to the emulator and save the component to a file. Finally, compile the emulator with Docker and save the output to a directory.

message.content:
```python
from emulator import Emulator, AutonomousSystem, Host, EthereumService, Blockchain, Node, Account, PhysicalNodeFilter

# Create emulator
emul = Emulator()

# Create 10 stub Autonomous Systems (AS) and hosts
as_list = []
host_list = []
for i in range(10):
    asys = AutonomousSystem(name=f"AS{i+1}")
    host = Host(name=f"Host{i+1}")
    asys.add_host(host)
    emul.add_autonomous_system(asys)
    as_list.append(asys)
    host_list.append(host)

# Create Ethereum service with saveState and override set to True
eth_service = EthereumService(saveState=True, override=True)

# Create two blockchains: POW and POA
pow_chain = Blockchain(name="POW_Chain", consensus="pow")
poa_chain = Blockchain(name="POA_Chain", consensus="poa")

# For each blockchain, create four nodes
pow_nodes = []
poa_nodes = []
for i in range(4):
    pow_node = Node(name=f"POW_Node{i+1}")
    poa_node = Node(name=f"POA_Node{i+1}")
    pow_chain.add_node(pow_node)
    poa_chain.add_node(poa_node)
    pow_nodes.append(pow_node)
    poa_nodes.append(poa_node)

# Set first two nodes as bootnodes and start mining
for node in pow_nodes[:2]:
    node.set_bootnode(True)
    node.start_mining()
for node in poa_nodes[:2]:
    node.set_bootnode(True)
    node.start_mining()

# For the third node of each blockchain, create accounts with a certain balance
pow_nodes[2].create_account(Account(balance=1000))
poa_nodes[2].create_account(Account(balance=2000))

# For the fourth node of each blockchain, set custom geth command options
pow_nodes[3].set_geth_options("--syncmode 'light' --cache 512")
poa_nodes[3].set_geth_options("--syncmode 'full' --cache 1024")

# Enable HTTP and WebSocket connections on certain nodes
pow_nodes[0].enable_http(True)
pow_nodes[0].enable_ws(True)
poa_nodes[1].enable_http(True)
poa_nodes[1].enable_ws(True)

# Set custom geth binary file on one of the nodes
pow_nodes[1].set_geth_binary("/usr/local/bin/custom_geth")

# Customize the display names of the nodes for visualization
pow_nodes[0].set_display_name("POW Bootnode 1")
pow_nodes[1].set_display_name("POW Bootnode 2")
pow_nodes[2].set_display_name("POW Account Node")
pow_nodes[3].set_display_name("POW Custom Node")
poa_nodes[0].set_display_name("POA Bootnode 1")
poa_nodes[1].set_display_name("POA Bootnode 2")
poa_nodes[2].set_display_name("POA Account Node")
poa_nodes[3].set_display_name("POA Custom Node")

# Bind the virtual nodes to physical nodes using filters
for i, node in enumerate(pow_nodes + poa_nodes):
    filter = PhysicalNodeFilter(hostname=f"phy-node-{i+1}")
    node.bind_to_physical_node(filter)

# Add blockchains to Ethereum service
eth_service.add_blockchain(pow_chain)
eth_service.add_blockchain(poa_chain)

# Add Ethereum layer to the emulator
emul.add_service(eth_service)

# Save the component to a file
emul.save_component("ethereum_emulator_component.yaml")

# Compile the emulator with Docker and save the output to a directory
emul.compile_with_docker(output_dir="emulator_output")
```
